title: Leading his own band at the Lafayette Theatre
summary: Zutty led his own band in a show at the Lafayette, with Tom Whaley conducting instead of Donald Haywood, Bubber Miley on trumpet and Gene Anderson on piano; Nina Mae McKinney hit an actor with a gun that jammed.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Well just before we finish off here. After this thing with Ally Ross he says here, led own band at the La Fayette. You led your own band?
Yes. Yes, I had Tom Whaley.

You see, it was my band. That's when (Nina May McKinney?), she was in the show. And (Plessey?), it was a spot where (Nina May McKinney?) was supposed to shoot this guy. And the gun wouldn't go off. So she walked over and hit him over the head with this pistol and blood started flying everywhere see? Because I'm the one that told him really to lead the band and the pit see? Because they had this other guy Haywood that wrote those bluer that Ethel Walters sang. What was his name? Donald Haywood, Donald Haywood.

And I didn't like the way he conducted at all, see? So I told Tom Whaley you going to conduct this band, see? With Schiffman and everything in there, he wanted Donald Haywood to direct the band and everything. Then I had old Bubber Miley on trumpet.
Oh, you had some good people in your band?
I had Big Green on trombone and Gene Anderson on piano. And I think Cotton was in there too.
But Zutty that was after you came out of Connie's Inn wasn't it?
Well according to this you know, after you came out of Connie's Inn with Ally Ross you had your own band at the La Fayette. Then joined Vernon Andrade's at the Renaissance.
